text: The rash is described as an erythematous maculopapular rash with pustules on an erythematous base, sparing the palms and soles, which is classic for congenital syphilis given the lack of prenatal care. REQUEST TEST: VDRL, Darkfield microscopy of lesion exudate, Long bone X-ray.
